propositions: Jira workflow constraints forbid direct end-state transitions (e.g. open->done when only open->in_progress->done is allowed), causing outbound sync to fail and tickets to drift.

The replay fallback reconstructs the recorded sequence of status hops from appended STATUS events, forward-maps local status names to Jira names via LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA, and re-executes the remaining hops through the existing transition_issue_by_name transport method.

Resume point matching occurs in Jira-name space by fetching the current issue status and anchoring on the last positional match in the recorded hop sequence, avoiding lossy inversion of the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map.
Replay aborts on any hop raising RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError, falling through to comment-fallback and drift; no partial hops are retried.
The replay call site is threaded through _update_one_scalar_update with local_id passed from the mutation, while tracker resolution is self-contained via config.tracker_dir(reconciler_repo_root()).
